summary: The proposal is missing several mandatory sections, including Introduction, Motivation, Objectives, and an AI Transparency statement, and it falls short on bibliography size, figure count, and UML inclusion. The schedule also contains prohibited thesis writing and documentation tasks and lacks proper iteration structuring. These critical gaps must be addressed before the proposal can be accepted.

findings.title: Missing Introduction section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Introduction section, which is required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Missing Motivation section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain a separate Motivation section, which is required by the guidelines.

findings.title: Missing Objective section with subsections
findings.description: The proposal lacks an Objective section that includes a bullet list of 3‑4 high‑level objectives and dedicated subsections for each.

findings.title: Missing AI Transparency Statement
findings.description: The proposal does not contain the required AI transparency statement.

findings.title: Insufficient bibliography entries
findings.description: Only five bibliography entries are provided; the guidelines require at least six to eight peer‑reviewed publications.

locations.quote: [Booch95]     Booch,     G.       Object-oriented    analysis    and   design    with   applications   (2.   ed.).

findings.title: Insufficient figures (only one provided)
findings.description: The proposal includes only a single figure, whereas at least two diagrams or figures are required.
